## Context / Problem
T3 (integration feasibility) and T10 (infra/IaC) have never blocked in ~2,500 runs each — a configuration artifact, not a quality signal: 13/20 sampled T3 findings were actionable codebase-grounded criticisms and 62% of T10's strong findings cite concrete repo artifacts. The audited T10 keyword gate measured 28% fire rate with 100% strong-finding recall. Operator approved enabling blocking for both. Plan-review blocking is derived from `default_posture: "blocking"` plus `block_threshold` in the routing entry (the `blocking_enabled` field is the code-review gate's convention and does not apply here), and there is no per-class blocking mechanism in Pass-3 — a finding blocks when its criterion is blocking-postured and its priority crosses the threshold.

## Approach
(1) In src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json set `default_posture: "blocking"` with `block_threshold: 0.90` for T3 and T10 (conservative pilot; the standing zero-LLM criterion-effectiveness recorder monitors outcomes for a later 0.85 revisit). (2) Class scoping for T10 is achieved through severity guidance, not a new mechanism: one sentence added to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T10.md stating that only its MAJOR classes (destructive apply, wildcard/overbroad grant, plaintext secret on a committed path, unauthenticated internet-reachable service) warrant severity >= major — so lesser findings cannot reach the 0.90 priority threshold through the existing severity->priority pipeline. No pass3_decide changes. (3) The T10 DET overlay gate is added as a DetGateRule in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_gate_rules.py (the established home for trigger vocabularies since change 1041), transcribed verbatim from the audit: text_all[0] = `\b(?:terraform|cloudformation|pulumi|ansible|kubernetes|helm|k8s|iac|aws|ec2|s3|iam|ssm|cloudwatch|vpc|sns|lambda|rds|ebs|docker|compose|infra/|provision\w*|systemd|launchagent|user_data|cloudfront|api gateway|oidc|\.github/workflows|github actions|workflow_dispatch|pull_request_target|secrets\.[A-Z_]+)\b` (case-insensitive), no file_impact arms. (4) tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py's pinned full-routing-table assertion is updated for the two posture changes in the same commit. (5) docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md regenerated with the documented command. Alternative rejected: enabling at 0.85 immediately — 0.90 first bounds the blast radius while the effectiveness recorder accumulates post-change data at zero LLM cost; and building a per-class blocking mechanism in Pass-3 — new machinery when severity guidance reaches the same outcome through the existing pipeline.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_gate_rules.py, src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T10.md, tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py (update pinned table), tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py (new), docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md (regenerated).

## Testing
Unit (relative imports): a T3 finding at priority 0.92 produces a blocking decision through Pass-3 and one at 0.85 stays advisory; same for a T10 fixture; the T10 DetGateRule fires on a terraform-touching fixture plan and a GHA workflow plan and skips a pure-docs plan with a routing.det_gated coverage entry and zero T10 LLM routing; the updated pinned routing table matches; the T10 rubric contains the severity-guidance sentence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] T3 and T10 carry default_posture blocking with block_threshold 0.90 and findings above/below the threshold block/stay-advisory through Pass-3 (checked: `pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py`).
- [ ] The T10 DetGateRule fires on infra and GHA fixtures and skips non-infra plans with a det_gated coverage entry (checked: unit tests).
- [ ] plan_review_T10.md contains the MAJOR-class severity-guidance sentence (checked: rubric text assertion).
- [ ] The pinned routing-table test reflects both posture changes and passes (checked: `pytest tests/unit/test_threshold_recalibration.py`).
- [ ] The criteria guide is regenerated (checked: committed regen output).
